title: Clario extraction v3
description: Single source of truth for diary-entry extraction. The app prompt, the vLLM guided-JSON schema, synth.py training targets and eval.py all use exactly this shape. Frozen 2026-10-15; change only with a version bump.

quote.description: Verbatim substring of the entry text (code drops the entity if not found)

canonical.description: Standard clinical English term, e.g. 'Malar rash'

hpo_id.description: Must be one of the ontology candidates offered, else null

negated.description: The entry says it is absent ('no fever', 'niente febbre')

family_history.description: It belongs to a relative ('my mother has lupus'), not the patient

onset_hint.description: ISO 8601 date or a relative phrase from the text ('since Tuesday'), else null

confidence.description: Model-reported; null for models not trained to emit it. The app's own confidence comes from self-consistency.
